notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Last Laugh's first ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each creature and each player.
Polyraptor triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat, sacrificing the damaged Polyraptor instead.
